s: small-batch neighbourhood bakery from a baking-instructor founder
w: A small, tightly focused Santa Monica bakery on Wilshire Boulevard, opened by a former baking instructor. The compact menu of breads and pastries changes with the seasons, favouring quality and technique over volume -- a return to the neighbourhood-bakery model in a city more used to big-batch chains.
_facts: Located at 1209 Wilshire Blvd, Santa Monica, CA 90403
Opened by a founder with a baking-instructor background
Small, tightly curated bread and pastry menu
